messages.subject: Hadoop - EL to AL
parts:
Hi,

I'm trying to implement a rmr2 code to transform a edge list to a sparse adjacency list for an undirected graph on a map reduce environment...

The input is similar to this example:

1 2
1 3
2 3
3 4
6 5
5 3
9 6

and the output required is this:

1 2 3
2 1 3
3 1 2 4 5
4 3
5 3 6
6 5 9
9 6

I'm trying to do it with this following code but I'm not getting there. I'm still learning how to work with RHadoop so any advise on this is much appreciated.

#! /usr/bin/env Rscript
Sys.setenv(HADOOP_CMD="/usr/bin/hadoop")
 Sys.setenv(HADOOP_HOME="/usr/lib/hadoop-0.20/bin")
 Sys.setenv(HADOOP_STREAMING="/usr/lib/hadoop/contrib/streaming/hadoop-streaming-0.20.2-cdh3u5.jar")

library(rmr2)
map <- function(k,v) {
   fields <- unlist(strsplit(v, "\t"))
   keyval(k=unique(c(fields[1], fields[2]),if(fields[1]==k){v=fields[2]}else{v=fields[1]}))
}

reduce <- function(k,vv) {
   keyval(k, (unlist(vv)))
}

kvtextoutputformat = function(k,v) {
paste(c(k,v, "\n"), collapse = "\t")
}

mapreduce(
input = "Tests.txt",
output = "output-RHadoop",
#textinputformat = rawtextinputformat,
#textoutputformat = kvtextoutputformat,
output.format='text',
map = map,
reduce = reduce)

Thanks

messages.author: 6ac7e7dfbe4f6c38
messages.subject: Re: [RHadoop:#668] Hadoop - EL to AL
parts:
I am not sure I can follow your code, but the problem is well understood, so this is how I would go about it for directed graphs:

```
from.dfs(
  mapreduce(
    to.dfs(
      data.frame(
         from = sample(1:5, 10, T), 
         to = sample(1:5,10,T))), 
    map = function (k,v) keyval(v$from, v$to), 
    reduce = function (k,vv) keyval(k,list(vv))))
```

of course for a random graph, but I think it's better to keep parsing issues out of the logic  of the graph algorithm.  If this makes sense, great, otherwise feel free to shoot some questions back. Thanks


Antonio
